why: The AI panel connected facts that have no known link (parking with river temperature, parking with wind). From prompt v3 on, two facts may be discussed together only if a rule below names the link and the two readings are close in time and space. Everything else is described separately. A rule states a general physical or measurement relation; it is not evidence that the relation acted in this hour.

pattern_gate.note: No claim of a recurring pattern, rhythm or trend until the observatory's own record holds at least this many days of aligned readings; the record held about eight days when this rule was written.
